data.name: Flux3ImageToVideoNode
data.description: Animates 1 to 10 images with FLUX 3. Each image becomes a frame of the clip: one image opens it, two morph from the first to the second, and more are spread across it or pinned to times you choose.

input_details.name: prompt
input_details.tooltip: How the scene should move and sound; the prompt is interpreted and expanded before generation.

input_details.name: keyframes
input_details.tooltip: 1 to 10 images, in playback order. Minimum 256x256 pixels each.
input_details.hint: Auto-grow list: wire 1-10 IMAGE inputs as SEPARATE top-level entries named `keyframes.<slot>` (e.g. `keyframes.image_0`), never as an array under `keyframes`. Only `keyframes.image_0` is required; the rest are optional.

input_details.name: placement
input_details.tooltip: 'spread across the clip' lets FLUX 3 place the images (one opens the clip, two become its start and end); 'at times' pins every image to a second you choose.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `placement`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `placement.`, e.g. `placement.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `placement.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: placement.times
input_details.tooltip: One time in seconds per image, comma-separated and increasing, e.g. '0, 2.5, 5'.

input_details.name: aspect_ratio
input_details.tooltip: Output aspect ratio. 'auto' picks one from the prompt and inputs.

input_details.name: duration
input_details.tooltip: Clip length in seconds. 'auto' fits the length to the content.

input_details.name: generate_audio
input_details.tooltip: Generate synchronized audio (ambient, speech, effects). Off produces a video with no audio track.

input_details.name: safety_tolerance
input_details.tooltip: Moderation tolerance, 0 is the strictest. Requests that send images or video are capped at 2 whatever you set here.

input_details.name: seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed to determine if node should re-run; FLUX 3 picks its own seed, so actual results are nondeterministic regardless of this value.
